title: Cybersecurity and IT infrastructure — LucrumTech
description: Independent security assessment, penetration testing, and SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and HIPAA readiness. Two weeks, fixed fee, prioritised risk report you keep.
lede: Technology drives growth, and every system it runs on introduces risk. Vulnerabilities, breaches, infrastructure failures and thin security process threaten operations, reputation and continuity.
lede2: We help organisations build secure, resilient technology environments — and the point is not to hand you a list of vulnerabilities. It is to stop the incident happening.

offer.h2: A two-week security assessment. Fixed scope, fixed fee.
offer.body: We assess your infrastructure, test what an attacker would reach, and give you a prioritised risk report — what is exposed, what it would cost you, and what to fix first. The report is yours whether or not you continue with us.
offer.priceNote: Fixed fee. Engagements beyond the assessment are billed at USD 90 per hour.

infosec.h2: Find what is exposed, then close it.

items.p: Identifying weaknesses, testing system resilience and evaluating real attack scenarios.
Developing and implementing information security policies, standards and operational procedures.
Monitoring systems, detecting suspicious activity, and supporting investigation and response when something happens.
Securing networks, applications and essential systems while keeping the business running.
Security documentation, technical implementation, and preparing an organisation for certification against SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS or HIPAA.
Preventing data leakage, hardening applications and improving system resilience.
Assessing infrastructure, testing it, reviewing regulatory requirements and delivering a report you can act on.
Identifying, evaluating and prioritising risk — including the economic case for what you spend on security.

standards.body: Buyers, auditors and insurers all ask the same question: which standard are you measured against? Our team has delivered security work against the four that come up most often — and prepares an organisation for the audit rather than issuing the certificate itself.

items.p: Control design and evidence against the trust services criteria, in the state an auditor expects to receive it.
An information security management system that holds up — scope, risk treatment, the policy set and the records behind them.
Cardholder data environments: segmentation, control gaps, and what has to close before an assessment.
Safeguards for protected health information across systems, vendors and the people who handle it.

standards.note: For clients in the EU, controls are mapped to GDPR obligations as well.

infra.h2: Reliable infrastructure is the floor everything else stands on.

items.p: Evaluating environments and processes against technical, operational, compliance and security requirements.
Designing, deploying and configuring network infrastructure and equipment.
Improving performance, reliability and how resources are actually used.
Managing and optimising cloud environments, storage, backup and migrations.
Supporting users and maintaining servers and infrastructure, with extended-hours support by arrangement.
Keeping systems current and remediating vulnerabilities as they are disclosed.

approach.h2: Security belongs in the business strategy, not beside it.

steps.body: Understand the infrastructure, the security posture, the vulnerabilities and the business risk underneath them.
Identify the exposures that matter most and where spending will have the greatest effect.
Deploy practical measures, policies and technical solutions — not a document that sits unread.
Ongoing monitoring, maintenance and risk management once the fixes are in.
Keep strengthening the environment as the business and the technology change.

team.h2: Twelve specialists in security and infrastructure architecture.
team.body: Our cybersecurity and infrastructure team brings together twelve experienced professionals in information security, cybersecurity and infrastructure architecture.
items: Around ten years of average professional experience
Advanced academic qualifications, including doctoral degrees
Work delivered across Europe, North America and the Middle East
Banking, oil and gas, telecommunications, healthcare, software and publishing

closing.h2: Is your infrastructure ready for what comes next?
closing.body: Whether you need an independent assessment, a stronger security framework, infrastructure modernisation or ongoing expertise — start with the two-week assessment and decide from there.
